home.bio1: I am Associate Professor of Public Economics in the Department of Economics at the University of Messina, Italy. After graduating in Law from the University of Messina, I was awarded an M.Sc. in Economics from the University of York (UK), a PhD in Economics and Institutions from the University of Messina, and a PhD in Economics from the University of Essex (UK).
home.bio2: My research interests span public economics, regional economics, spatial econometrics, innovation and technology policy, and applied microeconometrics. In these pages you will find information about my research and teaching activities.

wip.title: NUTS2 Regional Panel Dataset (Eurostat × ARDECO)
wip.description: Construction of a NUTS2-level panel integrating Eurostat structural indicators with ARDECO regional accounts series (SNPCNP, SNMTN, PASSEN) for a long-run analysis of European regional productivity.

wip.title: Patent Inventor Location and NUTS2 Assignment
wip.description: Geospatial pipeline linking PATSTAT patent inventor addresses to NUTS2 regions via postcode parsing, ONSPD crosswalk matching, and bulk NUTS code reclassification for the 2021 revision.

wip.title: Inequality, Poverty, and Redistributive Policy
wip.description: Empirical analysis of inequality and poverty dynamics across Italian regions, with a focus on the distributional effects of fiscal transfers and public expenditure.

For queries about exam registration, office hours, or programme content, please use the contact form or write to my institutional email.

resources.intro: Curated resources for students and researchers: datasets, Stata code, and LaTeX templates.

blocks.title: Eurostat Regional Data
blocks.description: Official EU regional statistics at NUTS1/NUTS2 level, covering GDP, employment, population, and R&D expenditure.

blocks.title: ARDECO Database
blocks.description: Annual Regional Database of the European Commission (DG REGIO), providing long-run NUTS2 series for regional accounts.

blocks.title: PATSTAT
blocks.description: Worldwide Patent Statistical Database (EPO). Used for patent inventor geocoding and NUTS2 assignment.

blocks.title: Italian Regional Data
blocks.description: National sources for Italian regional analysis.

blocks.title: Spatial Econometrics
blocks.description: Code and notes for spatial regression models, including SAR, SEM, and SARAR IV estimation using the Kelejian–Prucha approach.

blocks.title: Panel Econometrics
blocks.description: Code for fixed effects, random effects, GMM, and dynamic panel models. Includes publication-quality table output via esttab.

blocks.title: Teaching Datasets
blocks.description: Datasets used in Financial Econometrics and Applied courses, suitable for replication exercises.

blocks.title: UniME Beamer Theme
blocks.description: Custom Beamer presentation theme for the University of Messina (beamerthemeUniME), installable as a local texmf tree entry for use across all projects.

blocks.title: TikZ Diagrams
blocks.description: Precision economic diagrams built in TikZ for lectures: supply & demand, perfect competition, Solow-Swan growth model, Gini/Lorenz curves.

blocks.title: Regression Tables
blocks.description: LaTeX table templates for publication-quality regression output, designed to match journal standards (AER, JEL style). Stata → LaTeX via esttab.
